Background photo: photorealistic, a small dark live-house stage seen from behind the performers — ten ancient Chinese figures in historical robes (Tang, Song, Han, Three Kingdoms and Spring-and-Autumn era clothing, topknots and headcloths, one of them a monkey king with a golden headband) stand shoulder to shoulder across the lower part of the frame with their backs to the camera, facing a dark hall filled with hundreds of raised smartphone flashlights (small cool-white light points, out of focus). One warm spotlight rims their shoulders. The photo is darkened and desaturated so the typography reads clearly; a fine film grain over the whole image.

Color system: near-black, mustard yellow (a muted golden yellow, like old taxi yellow or dijon — NOT bright lemon yellow, NOT neon), and off-white. Only these three colors.

Typography, all rendered exactly as written, all horizontally centered, generous side margins, meticulous kerning, nothing touching the edges:

1. Top kicker (about 8% from the top): a short thin mustard-yellow horizontal rule, and directly under it "ANCIENTS ON THE MIC" in a small refined condensed grotesk, capital letters, wide letter spacing, off-white, understated, about 2% of the image height. No other top text, no banner box, no Chinese line at the top.
2. The hero word, starting at about 17% from the top: "过来人" in an extremely heavy, modern, authoritative Chinese display typeface with sharp, clean, confident strokes — powerful like a premium film or major music-festival poster, refined and contemporary, NOT cartoonish, NOT rounded, NOT bubble type. Slightly condensed so the three characters span about 82% of the image width, about 18% of the image height. Filled with muted mustard yellow carrying a subtle, refined print texture: fine letterpress /silkscreen ink with slight tonal variation and visible paper fiber, matte finish, tasteful light wear — a premium hand-printed texture, not halftone dots, no cartoon outline. At most one thin off-white outline, exactly aligned with no offset. No gradient, no 3D bevel, no glow, no misregistration, no calligraphy.
3. Directly under it: "THE OGs" in a heavy but refined condensed grotesk, capitals, mustard yellow with a faint ink texture, about 6% of the image height, carefully letter-spaced.
4. The names block, the second-biggest element, from about 47% to about 77% of the image height: the ten names in a very heavy yet refined modern Chinese sans-serif, off-white, each name about 5.5% of the image height, generous line spacing, arranged in three rows: row one "杜甫 苏轼 刘邦 项羽", row two "勾践 孙悟空 曹操", row three "李白 诸葛亮 司马懿", with a small mustard-yellow dot between names on the same row. Every character must be correct and big enough to read in a phone thumbnail, without crowding.
5. Bottom block (bottom edge about 5% from the bottom): the hook line "这一场，没有对手" in a bold, refined Chinese sans-serif, mustard yellow, subtle print texture, about 4.5% of the image height; under it "喆 FILM" in a clean modern sans-serif, off-white, about 2.6% of the image height.
